colours.definition: Karsten's 'consistently cast': at least an (89 + mana value)% chance to have the coloured sources by the turn equal to the spell's mana value, on the play, in games with enough lands.
rules: A land that makes the colour is 1 source. On turn 1 only lands that can enter untapped count (a shock land or fast land can, and in Commander a bond land; a check land, gain land or basic-land fetch can't).

A land that searches for a basic land is a source of each colour of the basics in the deck (2/3 of one in decks needing 3 or more colours); one that searches for a land type, of each colour the deck's lands of that type make. Pathways: 2/3 each in decks needing 3+ colours.

A land whose search costs mana (Myriad Landscape's {2}) is a source only of the colours it makes itself until it can be used: paying {2} takes two other lands, so the lands it finds count from turn 4 (Karsten's full source is for searches that cost no mana, like Evolving Wilds).
A spell // land modal card is 0.8 of a source (1 if its land can enter untapped).

Mana creatures: 0.5 of a source from the turn after they're cast (turn 2 at the earliest). Mana rocks: 0.75 from the turn after they're cast (turn 3 at the earliest). 2-mana land ramp: 0.75 from turn 3; 3-mana land ramp: 0.5 from turn 5. Each only when the deck can cast the card itself consistently.
Cheap card draw (mana value 2 or less): each digs for lands, worth (sources of the colour / deck size) rounded down to a quarter, for spells cast after it; the first 10 only.
Exotic Orchard 0.75 and Fellwar Stone 0.5 of any colour (opponents unknown).
Not counted: Treasure, scry, and a Verge land's condition (it counts fully for both colours).
colours.table_note: Karsten publishes no source counts below 40 cards, so a 20-card deck gets its sources and requirements without a verdict. Check its 40-card pairings.

curve.average_mv_definition: Karsten's: the mana values of the library's nonland cards added up (each copy) and divided by their number. Lands are left out; a spell // land modal card counts as its front face; X counts as 0. The commander and companion are cast from outside the library, so they're left out (listed under outside).

guidance.note: 1 cards: using the 20-card guidance, the nearest deck size it covers (20, 40, 60).

formula.status: Not published by Karsten: his 60-card formula scaled by 20/60, the way he scales his 80-card one (our extrapolation). It fits all 10 Foundations Beginner Box halves within 0.97 lands and 118 of 119 Foundations Jumpstart lists within 1.
formula.text: lands = (20/60) x (19.59 + 1.9 x average mana value + 0.27 x companions) - 0.28 x cheap spells

rule_of_thumb.text: 8 lands (7 basics + 1 nonbasic); 9 in top-heavy or land-matters halves

lands.verdict_text: 6.88 fewer lands than the formula (more than 2 off).
